fullContentHtml:
NVS Class 11 Admissions Online Form 2027 – Extend – Full Details

Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti (NVS), has invited online applications for the Navodaya Vidyalaya JNV Selection Test for Class XI (2027- 28) on the official website of the NVS recently. Online registration process for NVS Class 11th Admission 2027 has started from 02 September 2026. The last date to apply for the NVS Class 11th Admission 2027 is 15 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for NVS Class 11th Admission Form 2027 which has given below. below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 02 September 2026
  • Last Date : 15 October 2026
  • Exam Date : 10 April 2027
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • There is no Application Fee for all categories

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

Important Links

  • Apply Online (Registration)
  • Apply Online (Login)
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

NVS Class 11 Admissions Online Form 2027 – Extend is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.
